(SELECT CONCAT(DATE(l.test_datetime), '|', l.cd4_count) FROM etl.flat_labs_and_imaging l WHERE l.person_id = p1.person_id AND l.cd4_count IS NOT NULL AND l.test_datetime >= p1.art_start - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND l.test_datetime < p1.art_start + INTERVAL 32 DAY ORDER BY l.test_datetime, l.encounter_id LIMIT 1)

(SELECT CONCAT(DATE(l.test_datetime), '|', l.hiv_viral_load) FROM etl.flat_labs_and_imaging l WHERE l.person_id = p1.person_id AND l.hiv_viral_load IS NOT NULL AND l.test_datetime >= p1.art_start + INTERVAL 2 MONTH + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND l.test_datetime < p1.end_6m + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY l.test_datetime DESC, l.encounter_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT CONCAT(DATE(l.test_datetime), '|', l.hiv_viral_load) FROM etl.flat_labs_and_imaging l WHERE l.person_id = p1.person_id AND l.hiv_viral_load IS NOT NULL AND l.test_datetime >= p1.end_6m + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND l.test_datetime < p1.end_12m + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY l.test_datetime DESC, l.encounter_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT CONCAT(DATE(l.test_datetime), '|', l.hiv_viral_load) FROM etl.flat_labs_and_imaging l WHERE l.person_id = p1.person_id AND l.hiv_viral_load IS NOT NULL AND l.test_datetime >= p1.end_12m + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND l.test_datetime < p1.end_24m + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY l.test_datetime DESC, l.encounter_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT o.value_coded FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.person_id = p1.person_id AND o.concept_id = 10988 AND o.obs_datetime < p1.end_6m + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT o.value_coded FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.person_id = p1.person_id AND o.concept_id = 10988 AND o.obs_datetime < p1.end_12m + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT o.value_coded FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.person_id = p1.person_id AND o.concept_id = 10988 AND o.obs_datetime < p1.end_24m + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT o.value_coded FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.person_id = p1.person_id AND o.concept_id = 1264 AND o.obs_datetime >= p1.art_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND o.obs_datetime < p1.art_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY o.obs_datetime, o.obs_id LIMIT 1)

(SELECT CONCAT( IFNULL(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN o.concept_id = 1264 THEN o.value_coded END ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC), ',', 1), ''), '|', IFNULL(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN o.concept_id = 1266 THEN o.value_coded END ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC), ',', 1), ''), '|', IFNULL(MAX(o.concept_id = 1265 AND o.obs_datetime >= p1.art_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH + INTERVAL 1 DAY), 0)) FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.person_id = p1.person_id AND (o.concept_id IN (1264, 1266) OR (o.concept_id = 1265 AND o.value_coded = 1850)) AND o.obs_datetime >= p1.art_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND o.obs_datetime < p1.end_6m + INTERVAL 1 DAY)

(SELECT CONCAT( IFNULL(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN o.concept_id = 1264 THEN o.value_coded END ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC), ',', 1), ''), '|', IFNULL(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN o.concept_id = 1266 THEN o.value_coded END ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC), ',', 1), ''), '|', IFNULL(MAX(o.concept_id = 1265 AND o.obs_datetime >= p1.end_6m + INTERVAL 1 DAY), 0)) FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.person_id = p1.person_id AND (o.concept_id IN (1264, 1266) OR (o.concept_id = 1265 AND o.value_coded = 1850)) AND o.obs_datetime >= p1.art_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND o.obs_datetime < p1.end_12m + INTERVAL 1 DAY)

(SELECT CONCAT( IFNULL(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN o.concept_id = 1264 THEN o.value_coded END ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC), ',', 1), ''), '|', IFNULL(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN o.concept_id = 1266 THEN o.value_coded END ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC), ',', 1), ''), '|', IFNULL(MAX(o.concept_id = 1265 AND o.obs_datetime >= p1.end_12m + INTERVAL 1 DAY), 0)) FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.person_id = p1.person_id AND (o.concept_id IN (1264, 1266) OR (o.concept_id = 1265 AND o.value_coded = 1850)) AND o.obs_datetime >= p1.art_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND o.obs_datetime < p1.end_24m + INTERVAL 1 DAY)

(SELECT CONCAT( IFNULL(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN o.value_coded NOT IN (2177, 2047, 10862, 9613) THEN o.value_coded END ORDER BY o.obs_datetime, o.obs_id), ',', 1), ''), '|', IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.value_coded), '')) FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.person_id = p1.person_id AND o.concept_id = 2051 AND o.value_coded IS NOT NULL)

(SELECT CONCAT( CASE o.value_coded WHEN 1832 THEN 1 WHEN 8291 THEN 2 WHEN 105 THEN 3 WHEN 6096 THEN 6 WHEN 8290 THEN 10 END, '|', DATE(COALESCE(e.encounter_datetime, o.obs_datetime))) FROM amrs.obs o LEFT JOIN amrs.encounter e ON e.encounter_id = o.encounter_id WHERE o.voided = 0 AND o.person_id = p1.person_id AND o.concept_id = 6578 AND o.value_coded IN (1832, 8291, 105, 6096, 8290) ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC, o.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)
